projects.name: OpenAI Stargate Abilene
projects.notes: First of several Stargate sites and the most complete to date. Four of eight buildings operational running Nvidia Blackwell at ~0.4 GW (Epoch AI tracked ~421 MW IT as of late May 2026); the remaining four buildings are now projected to complete around Q4 2026 for a full 1.2 GW campus — a slip from the earlier mid-2026 target (Oracle 15-year lease to deploy 450,000+ GB200 GPUs). Power is a mix of on-site natural gas plus grid (including local wind). OpenAI dropped a planned 2.1 GW expansion on this site — Crusoe is instead building two adjacent AI-factory buildings for Microsoft. Epoch estimates Buildings 3 and 4 became operational on May 23, 2026 (four buildings, ~590 MW). Buildings 5-8 are projected operational around November 1, 2026, which would take the site to ~1,180 MW.

projects.name: xAI Colossus 2
projects.notes: Follow-up to Colossus 1. Converted from an existing building. Natural gas turbines installed across the border in Mississippi. xAI now claims ~2 GW total Colossus capacity across both sites; Tesla Megapacks delivered to Memphis provide battery backup. Q1 2026 $659M building permit filed for a new 312,000 sq ft facility at 5414 Tulane Road. In May 2026 the NAACP sought an emergency injunction over the Southaven, MS gas-turbine plant powering Colossus 2, alleging up to 46 portable turbines were operating though Mississippi DEQ had permitted only 27. On June 15, 2026 the U.S. Department of Justice moved to intervene and dismiss the NAACP's Clean Air Act suit on national-security grounds (citing a DoD declaration describing Grok as a frontier AI model); xAI and Mississippi joined, and as of July 10, 2026 the judge had not ruled. Later filings put the turbine count at 57-59. In late June 2026 xAI filed roughly $300M in new construction permits across Colossus 1 and 2, including a ~$250M Colossus 2 Phase III expansion. Epoch AI's August 2026 assessment raises Colossus 2 sharply: ~1,276 MW total power (946 MW IT) and ~1.11M H100-equivalents as of June 15, 2026, making it the most powerful AI data center tracked. SpaceX S-1 filings describe a second cluster of 110,000 GB300 processors plus a further 220,000 GB300s and 400+ MW of compute power. Building 3 is projected to complete around February 2027, taking the site toward ~1.5 GW of IT power. Epoch now lists the owner as SpaceXAI following the SpaceX-xAI combination.

projects.name: PORTS Technology Campus (Piketon)
projects.address: Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant site, Piketon, OH (Pike County)
projects.notes: DOE public-private partnership announced March 20, 2026 to redevelop the decommissioned Portsmouth Gaseous Diffusion Plant into a campus targeting a 10 GW data center with up to 10 GW of new on-site generation (9.2 GW natural gas). SoftBank's SB Energy is partnering with AEP Ohio on generation and transmission, including $4.2 billion in grid upgrades, with $33.3 billion in Japanese funding tied to the gas generation. On August 18, 2026 OpenAI announced plans to lease much of the campus. No construction assessed yet; targets are developer/DOE projections.

timelineEvents.description: DOE, SoftBank/SB Energy and AEP Ohio announce the PORTS Technology Campus public-private partnership targeting a 10 GW data center and up to 10 GW of new generation at the former uranium enrichment site.
